text: I had a great experience with this dentist! The cleaning was incredibly thorough yet surprisingly quick. You can tell they pay close attention to detail. Just a heads up you’ll need to book your appointment in advance, but it’s absolutely worth it.

I’ve been coming to this clinic for over ten years, and today was unexpectedly my worst experience.

I went in for a cleaning with a dentist I had never met before, Dr. Nunhathai Chirdchutham. She arrived late to my appointment, which I understand—perhaps she had back-to-back patients (though my appointment was at 11 a.m., so I’m not sure how busy it was before I arrived). However, she didn’t greet me at all and went straight to work.

She seemed rushed and somewhat rude and impatient. When I asked if she could check whether I had any cavities, she quickly responded, “Look, if you want to know, we need to do a scan—I can’t fully see otherwise.” I wasn’t aware that a scan was required for confirmation, and she didn’t take even a moment to explain.

After I did the scan, when the results came out, Dr. Nunhathai rushed in and said, ฟันไม่ผุนะคะ โอเคนะคะ จบนะคะ - No cavities, okay? Everything’s fine, that’s it,” and then quickly left. I didn’t even get the chance to ask the questions I had in mind.

This clinic has had a great reputation for decades, and I’ve never encountered a dentist here with this kind of attitude. Highly recommend to ask who is your dentist before making a visit.

I had been suffering from eroded enamel, many old fillings and some jagged teeth and knew things were likely to deteriorate to the point of losing the functionality of some before too long.

I was reluctant at the outset to go through with the recommended ‘total mouth restoration’ but Dr. Suchada explained the thinking and rationale very well for me to finally accept I needed to do it. She made sure everything was done the right way (much as I hated the root canals 😆) and managed to save the tooth that looked destined to be replaced by an implant.

The end result has been beyond my expectations as the cores of all my teeth were saved and built on by crowns. They feel so much better (smooth, not jaggy), look so normal & healthy and now I should have far less problems in the future. My wife is also delighted that I am smiling properly again.

My tip: ask for the most experienced dentist available. You pay 20pct more but they are better. I had a wisdom tooth taken out painlessly. I also had a surgery to fix my infected gum. I go every 6 mo ths for cleaning and check up. It is very reasonable and staffs are super prefessional.

I told her I had never tried flossing before, and her surprised expression quickly turned into a warm smile. She kindly offered to give me a tutorial, walking me through the process step by step.

Thanks to P Nut, I not only learned how to floss properly but also had the most enjoyable teeth-brushing and mouth-washing experience of my life! Her patience, knowledge, and genuine care made all the difference.

Dental Joy lives up to its name—it’s not just a clinic but a place where learning about dental health is a joy. P Nut’s dedication and enthusiasm made my visit unforgettable. If you’re looking for a dental clinic with amazing staff, Dental Joy is the place to go!
